title: LandlordGuard Inspection Program: Findings, Condition Letters and Cures
content:
## Inspections

Every new LandlordGuard Dwelling Fire Policy receives one inspection of the tier's new-business inspection type, ordered no later than the tier's inspection order days after the bound date. A roof reinspection is ordered only to confirm a reported roof replacement. Inspections are ordered only while the policy is bound or in force, as the policy record shows.

## Condition letters

Each finding other than a clean result receives one condition letter, whose cure due date is the inspection completion date plus the tier's cure days, counted in calendar days.

## Extensions

- A cure extension is granted once per letter, for the tier's cure extension days, only when the landlord asks for it on or before the letter's current cure due date, and only on a tier whose cure extension days are above 0.
- A letter that has already been extended is never extended again; the extension record kept against that letter decides it.

## Cures

A condition is cured only when the proof of correction is received no later than the cure due date on the letter, as extended.

| Kind of finding | Findings | Proof accepted |
|---|---|---|
| Hazard findings | missing smoke detectors, missing handrails, unsecured vacant openings, deferred maintenance, debris hazard, roof defect | photographs or a contractor invoice |
| Eligibility findings | roof end of life, knob-and-tube wiring, fuse panel | a completed roof reinspection or a licensed electrician's certificate |

When a roof-end-of-life finding is cured by a new roof, the roof on file is updated, and the roof settlement basis becomes replacement cost where the tier's roof replacement-cost age is above 0.

## Effect of an uncured finding

A finding left uncured after its cure due date supports cancellation inside the new business period and nonrenewal afterwards; it never changes how a claim is paid.

## Hypothetical timeline

On a LandlordGuard DP-3 Special policy (cure period 45 days, one extension of 15 days) an inspection is completed on 1 April. The cure due date is 16 May. A landlord who asks for an extension on 16 May receives it, and the cure due date becomes 31 May; a second request is not granted. Proof received on 31 May cures the finding; proof received on 1 June does not.
